questions.q: A metal rod is divided into three parts, A, B and C. The lengths of A and B are in the ratio 9 : 20, and the lengths of C and B are in the ratio 5 : 11. If the difference between the lengths of A and C is 10 cm, find the total length (in cm) of the metal rod.
questions.explain: Given $A:B = 9:20$ and $C:B = 5:11$. To equate B's ratio, multiply the first by 11 and the second by 20. Then $A:B = 99:220$ and $C:B = 100:220$. The combined ratio is $A:B:C = 99:220:100$. Let lengths be $99x, 220x, 100x$. The difference between A and C is $100x - 99x = 1x = 10\text{ cm}$. Total length $= (99 + 220 + 100)x = 419x = 419 \times 10 = 4190\text{ cm}$.

questions.q: Which of the following ratios is equivalent to 3 : 2?
questions.explain: Simplify option D: Both $54$ and $36$ are divisible by $18$. $54 / 18 = 3$ and $36 / 18 = 2$. Therefore, $54 : 36 = 3 : 2$.
